name: subjects
description: Navigate the subject tree. Root (empty path) lists database folders (e.g. OSP_PUB); drill into sub-paths — entries with type "l" are folders, type "t" are tables.

path.description: Sub-path under the API base (default empty = root, lists databases like OSP_PUB).

name: table_meta
description: Table definition (dimensions, valid values). Use the bare table path with no ".px" suffix.

name: query_table
description: Pull data from a table. body is a PxWeb query object. Use the bare table path with no ".px" suffix.
